Scope: Focused Linux PowerShell module-mock checks and parser validation only. Availability, native authentication and drive checks are synthetic function replacements; no live scanner/SMB, Windows DPAPI, Windows PowerShell 5.1 execution, hospital workstation or actual timeout validation.

Checks.Name: Refresh accepts currently accessible read/list access.
Refresh verifies access once before reusing it.
Healthy reuse avoids native authentication and mapping operations.
Explicit supplied credentials still authenticate instead of reusing another session.
Explicit sign-in retains the post-authentication access check.
Explicit sign-in retains the existing occupied-drive check.
Unavailable access falls back to authentication then verifies access again.
Fallback performs the existing native authentication.
Rejected fallback credentials remain a failed connection with the original Windows code.
Existing no-credential access reuse is preserved.
The source folder, scanner settings and drive preference are unchanged.
Reuse remains inside the existing isolated 30-second reconnect deadline.
Older worker inputs without the optional flag default to explicit reconnect behavior.
The private worker forwards the optional reuse flag.
The report-refresh preconnection opts into verified access reuse.
The explicit sign-in route is not accidentally replaced by the refresh call.
App/Network.psm1 parses successfully in the executed PowerShell runtime.
App/TaskWorker.ps1 parses successfully in the executed PowerShell runtime.
App/WebService.psm1 parses successfully in the executed PowerShell runtime.
